name: PR439 frozen pre-W3 six-seed characterization

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-w3-prearm-20260922

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr439-w3-prearm-20260922
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  measure:
    name: Run governed pre-W3 arm on exact PR base
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      BASE_PRODUCTION_SHA: "876a3343319050187c2a5505b18cb32fc3d0f89d"
      REASON: "PR439 governed pre-W3 arm; measurement-only patch over exact PR base"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout evidence branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify evidence-only delta
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          changed="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE_PRODUCTION_SHA"...HEAD)"
          echo "Evidence head: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "Production base: $BASE_PRODUCTION_SHA"
          echo "$changed"
          unexpected="$(echo "$changed" | grep -vE '^$|^src/match-engine/tests/FoulRateDiagnosticTests\.cs$|^tools/dotnet-ci/parse_foul_card_characterization\.py$|^\.github/workflows/pr439-w3-prearm-evidence\.yml$' || true)"
          if [ -n "$unexpected" ]; then
            echo "::error::Unexpected path in pre-W3 measurement arm"
            echo "$unexpected"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set up .NET 8
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"

      - name: Resolve canonical instrument
        shell: bash
        env:
          INSTRUMENT: foul-rate
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py validate --repo .
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py resolve "$INSTRUMENT" --repo . --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build gate and run frozen pre-W3 instrument
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/measurements/trx
          OUT="artifacts/measurements/measurement.txt"
          MEASURE_OUT="artifacts/measurements/instrument-output.txt"
          RESULTS="artifacts/measurements/trx"
          RUNSETTINGS="artifacts/measurements/measurement.runsettings"

          cat > "$RUNSETTINGS" <<'XML'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <RunSettings>
            <RunConfiguration>
              <TreatNoTestsAsError>true</TreatNoTestsAsError>
            </RunConfiguration>
          </RunSettings>
          XML

          {
            echo "# Frozen PR439 governed PRE-W3 characterization"
            echo "# workflow event SHA: $GITHUB_SHA"
            echo "# production base: $BASE_PRODUCTION_SHA"
            echo "# evidence head: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            echo "# run: $GITHUB_RUN_ID"
            echo "# instrument: $MEASUREMENT_INSTRUMENT"
            echo "# reason: $REASON"
          } > "$OUT"

          set +e
          env -u "$MEASUREMENT_ENV" bash tools/dotnet-ci/run-gate.sh --test-filter "$MEASUREMENT_FILTER" 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUT"
          gate_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e
          if [ "$gate_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit "$gate_status"
          fi

          set +e
          env "$MEASUREMENT_ENV=1" dotnet test "$MEASUREMENT_PROJECT" --no-build --no-restore --filter "$MEASUREMENT_FILTER" --settings "$RUNSETTINGS" --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" --logger "trx;LogFileName=measurement.trx" --results-directory "$RESULTS" 2>&1 | tee "$MEASURE_OUT" | tee -a "$OUT"
          measurement_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e
          if [ "$measurement_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit "$measurement_status"
          fi

          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py verify-run "$MEASUREMENT_INSTRUMENT" --trx-dir "$RESULTS" --output "$MEASURE_OUT" | tee -a "$OUT"
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/parse_foul_card_characterization.py "$MEASURE_OUT" --pre-w3 --report-out artifacts/measurements/report.txt --tsv-out artifacts/measurements/results.tsv --json-out artifacts/measurements/results.json
          echo "# measurement verification: PASS" >> "$OUT"

      - name: Record hashes
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -d artifacts/measurements ]; then
            cd artifacts/measurements
            find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
          fi

      - name: Upload measurement evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr439-w3-prearm-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/measurements/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90
